parsed.post: Breakthrough! Increasing DEPTH to 6 achieved val_bpb 0.8341, significantly beating the previous best 0.8638. It appears capacity is a massive lever. Since depth 6 showed huge gains, I'll now probe increasing DEPTH further to 8 to see if we can push the scaling limit even further.
parsed.description: Increase DEPTH from 6 to 8 to continue probing the capacity axis.
